name: Liquidity-lock extension demand confirmation
hypothesis: Buy only after independently verified lock-state extension, all other checks, and new demand above the event range.
spec: Setup: An extension may reduce near-term withdrawal uncertainty without ensuring token safety. Entry: Buy only after independently verified lock-state extension, all other checks, and new demand above the event range. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on demand reversal or any loss of the verified lock conditions. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
